player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; you see only the opponent's card.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) each round, {max_rounds} round(s) total.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X is a positive integer <= your chip count.)
- Highest hidden card wins the pot at showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Pèsè ohun tí ó wà nínú àlàfo kan ní pàtó, bí àpẹẹrẹ, "[check]", "[bet 2]", "[call]", "[raise 3]", tàbí "[fold]".
invalid_move.cannot_check: Kò lè [check] - ẹ ń dojú kọ ìforítì.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Kò sí nǹkan láti pè; o lè [check] dípò.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Lo [bet X] láti ṣí; kò sí ìlépa láti gbé.
invalid_move.insufficient: Àwọn ẹyọ owó tí kò tó fún irú ìgbésẹ̀ yẹn.

board.possible_actions: Àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ tí o lè gbé: {legal}

message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: both {card}. Pot split – each receives {split}.

outcome.draw: Àwọn ẹyọ owó tó dọ́gba lẹ́yìn gbogbo ìyíká
